description: This file defines the BoxLayout class for the Kivy UI framework, including its properties, layout logic, and widget management methods.

classes.name: BoxLayout
classes.description: A layout class that arranges child widgets in a horizontal or vertical box, with support for spacing, padding, and position hints.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the BoxLayout instance and binds property changes to trigger layout updates.

methods.name: _iterate_layout
methods.description: Generator that computes the positions and sizes of child widgets based on layout properties.

methods.name: do_layout
methods.description: Performs the layout of child widgets by setting their positions and sizes.

methods.name: add_widget
methods.description: Adds a widget to the layout and binds its 'pos_hint' property to trigger layout updates.

methods.name: remove_widget
methods.description: Removes a widget from the layout and unbinds its 'pos_hint' property.
